methodology: TFR 1965-2025: WPP 2024 baseline via Demoria Research DHI dataset. Gulf states (ARE, SAU, KWT, QAT, BHR, OMN): nationals-only TFR series. ARE/SAU/OMN: confirmed NSO data (FCSC, GASTAT, NCSI) anchored 2010-2022, extended to 1965 using WPP shape with expat-share correction (0 at 1969, full at 2015). KWT/QAT: confirmed anchors to 2018/2019 respectively (Shah & Fargues; Fargues/PSA), estimated thereafter (flagged '~'). BHR: back-calculated from total TFR using nationals share (census 1991/2001/2010/2020) and assumed expat TFR 1.20 (flagged '~'). 2026 birth counts: partial-year NSO data where available.
